column2: A gaunt figure wading knee-deep in black swamp water with a knotted red cord tied around one wrist, glancing back over their shoulder, charcoal and sickly green palette, high fantasy oil painting

Two silhouetted hands clasping over still black water between tall dead reeds, faint witchlight rising from the handshake, desaturated charcoal and green palette, high fantasy oil painting, intimate close composition

An armoured figure buckling as black veins spread visibly up their neck and their sword arm goes slack, green fog curling low, charcoal and sick green palette, high fantasy oil painting, unsettling close shot
A ragged pale bat-thing with too many joints perched on a cypress branch above black water, witchlight caught in its eyes, drifting fog, bone and sick green palette, high fantasy oil painting

A tall figure in a wide black hat wading through the mire with a ledger held dry above the water, bone-pale roots parting ahead of them, charcoal and green palette, high fantasy oil painting, ominous stride
A knotted red cord snapping under a curved black blade, the severed ends whipping apart into smoke, a figure collapsing out of frame, charcoal red and green palette, high fantasy oil painting

A shambling line of pale drowned figures wading in single file through the fen, each holding a small green witchlight, mist to the waist, charcoal and luminous green palette, high fantasy oil painting

A small ancient woman seated on a cypress root above black water, smiling, hands folded, dozens of red cords trailing from her fingers into the mire, charcoal and green palette, high fantasy oil painting

A vast spectral hand of green witchlight rising from black water to close around a fleeing figure while a drowned shape stands up behind it, charcoal and green palette, high fantasy oil painting, dread scale
A young merfolk scribe underwater copying glyphs from a drowned stone wall onto a slate, hair drifting, shafts of pale light above, cool turquoise and silver palette, high fantasy oil painting

A wave caught mid-retreat pulling a struggling armoured figure backwards off a stone quay, spray frozen in arcs, cold cyan and pale grey palette, high fantasy oil painting, kinetic diagonal composition

A merfolk diver swimming down a flooded library corridor between shelves of sealed brass cylinders, one held to their chest, deep blue and verdigris palette, high fantasy oil painting, receding perspective
